display.purpose: Inter is reserved for the variable-font experiment.

headline.purpose: DM Sans gives page and section headings one clear voice.

body.purpose: DM Sans carries prose at a generous line height.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono marks dates, reading time, and code.

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The default inline navigation and citation treatment.
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: #233044; font: 500 16px/1.7 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 2px; text-decoration-color: #B9BDC3; transition: color 150ms ease, text-decoration-color 150ms ease; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: #393F48; text-decoration-color: #393F48; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #393F48; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Compact primary navigation for Blog and About.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #4C586A; font: 700 13px/1.4 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 2px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #393F48; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #393F48; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Quiet Container
components.description: A grouped surface used only when a border clarifies meaning.
components.css: .ds-container { padding: 16px; color: #233044; background: #F7F7F7; border: 1px solid #CFD2D6; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 16px/1.7 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: A compact light and dark theme action.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 48px; height: 24px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; color: #233044; background: #F0F0F0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background: #E3E3E3; } .ds-theme-toggle:active { transform: scale(.96); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #393F48; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Metadata Label
components.css: .ds-meta { color: #4C586A; font: 600 13px/1.7 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; }

narrative.overview: The site should feel like a carefully maintained README that grew into a personal home. Writing is the main material. Navigation, metadata, links, and code support the reading path without turning the site into documentation software or a generic developer portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Text-first layouts with a maximum content width of 899px.
DM Sans for reading and JetBrains Mono for compact metadata.
Light and dark neutral themes with rare functional brand color.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and restrained one-pixel borders.
Clear links and small, direct interaction feedback.

rules.name: The Existing Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep the current light and dark values until a separate palette decision approves changes.

rules.name: The Readability Rule
rules.body: Normal text must meet WCAG AA against its actual background.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Body copy keeps at least a 1.7 line height and a readable 65-75ch measure.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to ordinary content, links, code, or cards.

dos: Do let writing determine layout and spacing.
Do use semantic tokens and verify their contrast in context.
Do keep links visibly interactive before hover.
donts: Don't build a generic developer portfolio from repeated cards and technology logos.
Don't use SaaS landing-page cliches, gradients, glass panels, or inflated claims.
Don't use editorial-magazine styling as decoration rather than to improve reading.
Don't use terminal cosplay or monospace as a substitute for design.
Don't add decorative motion or color that competes with long-form content.
